<summary>Consolidated revenue for H1 2026 was KRW 261.6 billion, down from KRW 402.4 billion in H1 2025.
 Operating income for H1 2026 was KRW 63.8 billion, compared to KRW 75.9 billion in H1 2025.
 Net income for H1 2026 was KRW 60.0 billion, down from KRW 165.1 billion in H1 2025.
 Basic EPS for H1 2026 was KRW 1,769, compared to KRW 4,867 in H1 2025.
 Cash and cash equivalents at June 2026 were KRW 340.3 billion, up from KRW 94.3 billion at December 2025.

  Q1 2026 [...] The company underwent a major change in ownership, with HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering acquiring a 35.05% stake and becoming the largest shareholder as of July 2024.
 The company changed its name to HD Hyundai Marine Engine Co., Ltd. and completed the sale of a major plant, improving its financial structure.
 The main business is marine engines, with 77.7% of sales from ship engines and 22.3% from engine parts and services.
